player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Decktech''') posted a [[Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list on DeckTech in April 2001.
description: OK, It's a average ISB. But there is more counter-defensive that in any usual ISB deck.
cards: posted: Opressive Enforcement / There is no Try
Shut Him Up Or Shut Him Down
posted: Something Spacial Planed For Them
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting': ISB Operations (posted 'ISB Opperation'), Coruscant, 'IAM', Mobilization Points ('Mob Point'), There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement ('Opressive Enforcement / There is no Try') and Prepared Defenses ('Prepared Defence'); these count toward the 60. Several Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so none is set.
'BIG RED' (above the Interrupts/Effects; the strategy calls counter cards 'red') and 'ORDER' (above Battle Deployment) are section headers, not cards; without them the list adds to 60.
'IAM' is printed as written: no card has that name; it is a starting Effect pulled by Prepared Defenses, probably Imperial Arrest Order, but the name does not settle it.
'Grapler' is printed as written: several Dark cards fit 'Grabber' (the strategy says he can 'grab Hyper Escape'); same precedent as 'Grapler' in DeckTech 16459.
Posted 'Coruscant' dested the Dark Special Edition Coruscant system (the Coruscant set was not out in April 2001); 'Hoth', 'Yavin 4' and 'Kashyyk' dested the Dark system pages.

Posted 'Darth Vader Foil Japaneese (tech)' dested the Premiere Darth Vader (a Japanese foil printing of that card); 'Tarkin' dested Grand Moff Tarkin; 'Cabble' dested Lieutenant Cabbel (an ISB agent); '5d6' dested 5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix); 'Chirano' dested Admiral Chiraneau; 'Comender Merjerk' dested Commander Merrejk; 'Captain Godhert' dested Captain Godherdt; 'U-3po' dested U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio).
Posted 'Bargaining Table' (a Light Jabba's Palace Effect) dested Den Of Thieves, its Dark counterpart with the same text, since this is a Dark deck.

Posted 'Massa Move' dested Masterful Move; 'Abysin Ornement' Abyssin Ornament; 'Blast Doo Control' Blast Door Controls; 'YCHFE' You Cannot Hide Forever; 'SHUOSHD' Shut Him Up Or Shut Him Down; 'BIHT', 'ZIMH', 'DIP1' Bossk In Hound's Tooth, Zuckuss In Mist Hunter, Dengar In Punishing One; 'Executo' Executor; 'Bliz 2' Blizzard 2.
Secret Plans was an Effect in 2001, not a Defensive Shield.
